originalAlarm.description: The value written to `&m_has_modinfo` is never used.

reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: Same file as PRODUCT_34/38 (5275b1e49f6.c). The alarm reports 'm_has_modinfo = 1' (line 18, else branch) as a dead store when CONFIG_FEATURE_INSMOD_VERSION_CHECKING=false. When VERSION_CHECKING=false, k_crcs is not declared (#ifdef guard), m_has_modinfo is assigned in the if-else block but never subsequently read in the simplified file. In the real BusyBox insmod_main() code, m_has_modinfo is used throughout the function. The simplified file stripped those uses. This is a simplification artifact. The known vbdb bug is UndeclaredIdentifier: k_crcs is used at line 25 (unconditionally) but is only declared inside #ifdef VERSION_CHECKING — so when VERSION_CHECKING=false, k_crcs is undeclared.
